instruction: All priors hypotheses are scoped to source granularity and local verification; no numeric prior invented or newly validated N1–N3.

entries.hypothesis: Locally rescued originals can reproduce past derived counts without new network or Actions
entries.for: 11/11 file hashes, lengths and ZIP CRC; PDF source hash independently reproduced vs manifest.
entries.uncertainty: No publisher signature or first-publication proof. Manifest and hashes from same archival chain.

entries.hypothesis: A Senate session header date can safely date every vote in its XML
entries.update: Use per-vote date and do not map 259 name-only matches to date-valid person records.

entries.hypothesis: Oct 26 Congress active roster is full historical voter eligibility set
entries.for: 37% of term snapshot active labels in October (137 of 412)
entries.against: All four July/Sept nominal votes 350 rows vs 137 current active and 275 discharged; 213 term records date discharge 06/10/2026
entries.uncertainty: Snapshot term-end does not yield precise original publication time or stable person IDs.
entries.update: Historical validity intervals and parliamentary term scope separate from current status.

entries.hypothesis: Normalized full names alone form unique longitudinal person IDs across national elections
entries.for: No duplicate normalized full name within each of sixteen separate 350-seat elections
entries.against: 1306 labels repeat across dates; 103 change province and 576 candidacy acronyms; true same-person ground truth still absent
entries.uncertainty: These repeats may represent real re-election, career moves, party switches or homonyms; cannot estimate error rate.
entries.update: Name-only links are candidates, not certified; use independent dossiers and alternatives.

entries.hypothesis: Congress 'asiento' is injective person key for one nominal voting event and stable across event dates
entries.for: 339/339 assigned seat pairs stable between same-session July votes
entries.against: '-1' repeated 11,11,15,30 per event; among paired dates up to four identical non-sentinel seats map to different names and dozens of same-name labels have changed seats.
entries.uncertainty: Inferred seat reassignment does not certify individual person identity, only label/seat observations.
entries.update: '-1' missing sentinel; never key on seat alone.

entries.hypothesis: Official 2023 national elected list and Interior election report agree province by province
entries.for: BOE-JEC 350 names over 52 provinces vs Interior 350; 50/52 exact, 346/350 strict name matches; four textual exceptions contextually explainable, all province counts align.
entries.against: Abbreviation, alias, narrative annotation, layout extraction create 4 nonexact strings.
entries.uncertainty: Contextual matching by surname, province and visual source is not independently adjudicated personal identity; BOE/Interior may share upstream electoral proclamations.
entries.update: Separate exact source label match from context-confirmed editorial equivalence.

entries.hypothesis: Local source QA can guard catastrophic sentinel/aggregate issues without raw nominal publishing
entries.for: 8/8 regression tests and 4/4 original Congress vote replay via independent QA code
entries.against: No failing tests in bounded suite.
entries.uncertainty: No verified HTTP integration or CI clean checkout. Pure code correctness is not provider-authentic source validation.
entries.update: Keep fail-closed guards, record source SHA and quarantined exceptions.
